root_cause.text: A race condition in z_erofs_decompress_kickoff() where it accesses sbi->sync_decompress after queueing asynchronous work that can complete and allow filesystem unmount to free sbi before that access, leading to use-after-free.
root_cause.evidence: The patch moves the assignment `sbi->sync_decompress = EROFS_SYNC_DECOMPRESS_FORCE_ON` to before `queue_work()` or `queue_work_on()`, preventing the access after the work is scheduled. The CVE description and commit message explicitly state the race: "access sbi->sync_decompress after all folios are unlocked and unmount proceeds, causing UAF".

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix potential sleeping in atomic context by forcing synchronous decompression in atomic context when the user-configured sync_decompress mode is 'auto'.
intent_record.what: Added a conditional check inside `z_erofs_decompress_kickoff` that, when in atomic context and `sbi->sync_decompress` equals `EROFS_SYNC_DECOMPRESS_AUTO`, overrides it to `EROFS_SYNC_DECOMPRESS_FORCE_ON`.
intent_record.how: This change ensures that decompression in atomic context always uses synchronous (non-sleeping) mode when the sysfs parameter is set to 'auto', preventing possible sleep-in-atomic issues.

intent_record.intent_summary: Remove automatic switching of sync_decompress from AUTO to FORCE_ON after queuing work, preventing unintended side effects and preserving the configured decompression mode.
intent_record.what: Removed three lines that conditionally set sbi->sync_decompress to EROFS_SYNC_DECOMPRESS_FORCE_ON when it was previously EROFS_SYNC_DECOMPRESS_AUTO, along with the associated comment.
intent_record.how: After queueing work in the #else branch of z_erofs_decompress_kickoff, the code no longer automatically changes the sync_decompress sysfs parameter from AUTO to FORCE_ON. This means the decompression mode remains as configured unless manually changed via sysfs.

grouping_result.intent: Fix potential sleeping in atomic context by forcing synchronous decompression in atomic context when the user-configured sync_decompress mode is 'auto'.
Remove automatic switching of sync_decompress from AUTO to FORCE_ON after queuing work, preventing unintended side effects and preserving the configured decompression mode.

relevance_review.reason: Group 0 addresses a sleeping-in-atomic-context bug by forcing synchronous decompression in atomic context, which is a different issue from the race condition use-after-free caused by accessing sbi->sync_decompress after queueing asynchronous work. The changes do not directly target or fix the race condition described.

The group removes a write to sbi->sync_decompress after queueing asynchronous work, which is the exact pattern that can lead to a use-after-free race condition when the work completes and unmount frees sbi. The change directly addresses the vulnerability root cause.

vuln_statements.explanation: This statement accesses sbi->sync_decompress after asynchronous decompression work has been queued. If the work completes and triggers filesystem unmount, sbi may be freed, leading to use-after-free on this access.
This statement also accesses sbi->sync_decompress (writes to it) after asynchronous work is queued. The same race condition allows use-after-free if sbi is freed before this write.
